core_obligations: Reduce to X = Spec(A) affine using the locality of the normalization, with X' = Spec(A') and A' the integral closure of A in the global sections of Y (proof lines 10118-10120).
Identify the codimension zero point x' with a minimal prime of A' (proof lines 10120-10121).
Choose an affine etale cover V = Spec(B) -> Y and note that A' -> B is injective (proof lines 10121-10123).
Apply the algebra lemma to see that the minimal prime of A' is the image of a minimal prime of B, i.e. of a codimension zero point of Y (proof lines 10123-10126).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism f : Y -> X of schemes with normalization X' -> X of X in Y, every codimension zero point x' of X' is the image of a codimension zero point y of Y (source lines 10107-10115). The proof reduces to an affine base X = Spec(A) using etale locality of the normalization, so that X' = Spec(A') with A' the integral closure of A in the global sections of Y and x' corresponds to a minimal prime of A'; choosing a surjective etale V = Spec(B) -> Y with V affine, the map A' -> B is injective, so every minimal prime of A' is the image of a minimal prime of B by the algebra lemma on minimal primes.
